title: Fixed Folded Hollow Shell and Raised Wire Handle Clip
description: One newly authored complete empty folded-shell binder-clip exterior. One continuous thick folded triangular shell wraps a true axial hollow and leaves a finite front mouth. Two complete rolled edge sleeves terminate the open shell, each carrying a complete raised bent wire handle with retained roots. No old jaw or handle is imported. Unlike the old staple remover there are no crossed fork jaws or four claw tips; unlike the nail clipper there are no opposed bowed cutting plates or top lever on a retaining post. Three opaque PBR roles, metres Z up, centred ground datum, one model zero scenes. Fixed static stationery display only: no elastic action, clamping force, paper fit, operation or safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.
